summary: The Form 8-K filed by BANK5 2024-5YR11, with Morgan Stanley Capital I Inc. as registrant, reports a routine servicing arrangement for the Colony Square loan combination under the BMO 2024-5C8 PSA. Effective July 29, 2026, CWCapital Asset Management LLC replaces Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer, appointed by directing certificateholder 400 Capital Management. No deal terms, prices, or strategic actions are involved. This is an administrative servicing notice, not a special-situation event, and no risk-arb angle applies.
